_comment: Local model deployment for the development machine measured 2026-08-05:
Intel Core Ultra 7 255U (Arrow Lake-U), AI Boost NPU driver 32.0.100.4724,
Intel Graphics 4 Xe-LPG cores / 64 EU @ 2.1 GHz, 47.5 GB shared RAM.
gatePassed is a claim about a (model, device, runtime) triple, not about a
model. A profile that passed on Ollama/CPU has NOT passed on NPU: the
quantisation and the runtime both change, so the vectors and the labels can
change with them. Re-run cortex-eval against the deployed endpoint before

profiles.note: Target for the hot path. The model passed the retrieval gate at Recall@k 1.00 / nDCG 0.96 as qwen3-embedding:0.6b on Ollama; the NPU deployment must re-pass it before this flag moves.
Named as NPU-supported by OpenVINO GenAI. Must pass the local_small gate: classification >= 0.80 and zero missed escalations.

Quality tier, off the hot path: precompute a per-revision structural digest and cache it. 4 Xe cores are slow, which costs nothing here because nothing waits on it. The model passed local_medium with perfect citation preservation on CPU; the GPU placement must be re-measured.
